pageProps.title: The Dangerous Venus
pageProps.review: A review of Keigo Higashino's mystery novel, which uses mathematics and neuroscience to contain the author's deep reflection on fanatical intellectual greed and bioethics hidden behind the inheritance cliché.
pageProps.content:
## Review Mathematics and neuroscience were brought in as the central subjects of the work. Combining scientific knowledge with the mystery genre seems to be the biggest feature that defines his world of work.
It distracts the reader's attention by presenting the classic mystery cliché of inheritance. Readers familiar with the mystery genre naturally focus on ```who caused the incident because of money```. However, the motive was pure yet fanatical intellectual greed.
The author's deep interest in neuroscience and bioethics is evident.
